caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a mottled brown coloration. The pitcher has a large handle on the left, which includes sculpted elements that resemble an animal’s head. The body of the pitcher features sculpted reliefs of hanging game animals, specifically two birds and a rabbit, all depicted as if suspended upside-down by their feet. Each animal is vertically arranged and occupies a separate panel-like section on the pitcher’s surface. The top rim of the pitcher is uneven and slightly wavy, and the overall shape is irregular, with angular creases along the sides. The background is a plain light beige color, providing contrast to the brown tones and textured details of the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
